text:
ash: Heads up — noticing a weird shelf-lockchain on rack-a3, small pods stuck pending even though GPU util is low.
ash: Looks like attach/detach churn + a taint bounce is preventing rebalance.
maria-r: @ash can you paste the node annotations and pod events for one of the affected nodes?
ash: pasted one excerpt below:
```\nNode: rack-a3-n12\nAnnotations:\n  gpu.shelf/locked-by: scheduler-v2\n  scheduling.k8s.io/lastObserve: 2026-03-21T10:42:01Z\nEvents:\n  Warning AttachFailed: volume attach timeout\n  Normal KubeletEviction: pod preempted for binpack\n```\nlee: That attach timeout smells like the NVMe attach race we saw last month — but why are tiny inference pods staying pending? Should be preempted/fitted elsewhere.
kai: Could be our binpacker treating shelf locks as hard affinity. We added a soft-affinity tweak last week, might have accidentally flipped to strict for fractional GPUs.
ash: repro steps: burst a bunch of <0.5-gpu> pods in eu-west1b, autoscaler ramps nodes, but scheduler can't move pods off locked shelves because node taint is toggling every ~20s.
sre-oncall: I pulled the scheduler logs for that timeframe — getting a lot of "node predicate failed: shelf-lock" entries. Snippet:
```\n2026-03-21T10:41:59Z scheduler INFO pod=ml-infer-xyz predicate: shelf-lock conflict: node=rack-a3-n12\n2026-03-21T10:42:03Z scheduler INFO evict plan created for pod ml-infer-abc but bind failed -> retry\n```\ndevops-bot: deploy bot: rolled back scheduler-config v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 at 10:44 (triggered by ash).
maria-r: good call. @devops-bot can you also temporarily remove the shelf taint from rack-a3 nodes as a mitigation so we can drain and defragment?
devops-bot: run: kubectl taint nodes rack-a3-n* gpu.shelf=locked:NoSchedule-  (dry-run suggested)
lee: If we remove taint we should set a quick descheduler job to coalesce tiny pods into warm nodes, otherwise we'll keep spinning. Suggest a 10m window.
kai: Also recommend a short throttle on attach/detach reconciler — the rapid flip is creating backpressure where kubelet re-applies the shield annotation and scheduler sees it as new contention.
ash: Follow-up: I ran `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending` and filtered by node affinity; ~42 small pods pinned to rack-a3 nodes.
maria-r: I'll open a canary run to test v2.3.0 schedule behavior with a production-like burst. If that looks stable we'll keep rollback and patch v2.3.1.
sre-oncall: Monitoring note: tokenized backlog up 30% during the incident window, cost bump visible on token-per-second metric for hatched retries. Putting an alert on attach/detach error rate.
ash: Temporary workaround executed: removed taint on rack-a3, kicked descheduler, nodes drained, ~90% of pending pods scheduled onto warm-pool nodes.
lee: Postmortem actions: 1) revert strict affinity change in binpacker config, 2) add canary for attach/detach throttle, 3) add metric for "shelf-lock churn".
kai: I'll file the config PR and include a small e2e that simulates attach contention.
maria-r: Thanks all — reassigning follow-ups to infra-ops. :thumbsup:
